goal.justification: The complete 37-function Picture Poker text run is reconstructed as real dScMgCard_c, dMgCardObj_c and dMgDilarCardObj_c C++, plus its adjacent unique MG_CARD classInit and four narrow construction/destruction-array ABI callbacks. All behavior lives on RTTI-proven classes, every raw this-offset chain remains retired, and the shared 0x270 state is a typed member. The callbacks are retained only at measured mwccarm walls: CW 1.2 rejects every placement-new route for the folded factory, and genuine base/derived card lifecycle can reproduce every body but not the cartridge's scene-D1, scene-D0, base-D1, derived-D1 section order.

compiler_only_output, measured pre-link in this worktree with .rela.data slots masked as wildcards the way tools/match.py masks .text: the six typeinfo NAME STRINGS carry no relocations and every byte of each equals the cartridge (_ZTS7fBase_c 9/9, _ZTS7dBase_c 9/9, _ZTS8dScene_c 10/10, _ZTS11dScMgBase_c 14/14, _ZTS19dScMgSingle3DBase_c 22/22, _ZTS11dScMgCard_c 14/14). The six typeinfo RECORDS are 100% relocation words (8 or 12 bytes, 0 comparable), so nothing about them can be judged before the link -- romdata_check during rombuild is the authority, not this object. _ZTV11dScMgCard_c has exactly one non-relocated word, the offset-to-top, and it equals the cartridge: note the config symbol addr:0x0213bdb4 names the vtable's ADDRESS POINT, so the record starts 8 bytes earlier at 0x0213bdac, where the cartridge holds 0 then 0x0213bc70 (_ZTI11dScMgCard_c) -- comparing at the configured address without that -8 makes every word look wrong. The object emits 0x50 bytes = the 8-byte header plus 18 slots; the cartridge's table runs 0x0213bdb4..0x0213be44 = 144 bytes = 36 slots, so this vtable  2026-08-31 addendum, same masking methodology, for the six element-class records the mArray1/mArray2 retype added (the header now defines dMgCardObj_c/dMgDilarCardObj_c, keying their records here): _ZTS12dMgCardObj_c 15/15 and _ZTS17dMgDilarCardObj_c 20/20 raw bytes equal the cartridge at 0x0213bc8c/0x0213bc9c; _ZTI12dMgCardObj_c (8 bytes) and _ZTI17dMgDilarCardObj_c (12 bytes) are 100% relocation words like the scene records -- the retail extract marks pointer-shaped words at exactly the positions my relocations occupy, word for word, and every one of my targets resolves to the address the cartridge word holds: the __class_type_info/__si_class_type_info vtable address points 0x0209a77c/0x0209a76c, the own name strings, and the si-form base word 0x0213bc48; and the two element VTABLES are complete three-slot records in the cartridge (record starts 0x0213bcc4/0x0213bcec -- the config symbols 0x0213bccc/0x0213bcf4 name the ADDRESS POINTS, the same convention as _ZTV11dScMgCard_c above): the raw offset-to-top word equals the cartridge, and my four relocated words resolve to the cartridge slot addresses in cartridge order -- 0x0213bc48 plus 0x020d9bdc/0x020d9c5c/0x020d9bd0 (Render/Update/GetOffscreenY) for dMgCardObj_c, and 0x0213bc58 plus 0x020d970c/0x020d978c/0x020d9998 for dMgDilarCardObj_c. romdata_check during the production rombuild stays the authority for all of these; this is the pre-link evidence the baseline linkcheck cannot make, because it deadstrips my copies before the link and links the retail gap copies.

The destructor is defined INLINE in include/dScMgCard_c.h, not out of line in this TU. Out of line, mwccarm emitted _ZN11dScMgCard_cD0Ev AHEAD of _ZN11dScMgCard_cD1Ev and rombuild's fail-closed isolate refused the object -- the cartridge has D1 first at 0x020d95a4 and D0 second at 0x020d9638. Inline, vtable slots 16 and 17 name D1 then D0 and odr-use both, so the compiler emits the pair in cartridge order; the key function moves to InitResources, the next virtual declared and non-inline, which this same TU defines, so _ZTV11dScMgCard_c is still emitted here. It also removes _ZN11dScMgCard_cD2Ev entirely, so that symbol needs no deadstrip policy. Same recipe and same reason as ov006/dScMgMCarlo2_c.

2026-09-03 full-boundary consolidation: the original 34-function scene/card promotion ended at 0x020dbd54, but the immediately adjacent MG_CARD classInit and two card constructors extend the same original TU through 0x020dbe40. The text run, RTTI/vtable/profile data at 0x0213bc44..0x0213be44, __sinit_ov006_021300b0 and its ctor pointer, and BSS at 0x02141768..0x021417b0 all terminate where dScMgCoin_c begins. The retired MgPicturePoker.cpp was therefore a three-function fragment of this class TU, not a separate source boundary.

MEASURED CW 1.2 ABI WALLS: genuine out-of-line dMgCardObj_c/dMgDilarCardObj_c constructors and destructors make the derived bodies 0x24 bytes by calling the base C2/D2, not the cartridge's 0x1c-byte folded stores. Marking the base lifecycle inline makes all four C1/D1 bodies byte-identical, but mwccarm emits base D1 between the scene D1 and scene D0 instead of the cartridge's scene-D1, scene-D0, base-D1, derived-D1 order. Swapping source definitions and the force-inline pragmas do not change that order. A semantic placement-construction factory is also unavailable: this compiler rejects class, global, and placement operator-new declarations and supplies no placement-new builtin. The four C1/D1 callbacks and dScMgCard_c_classInit are consequently the smallest literal ABI bridges; the classes, ownership, behavior, layout and shared state remain genuine typed C++.

FOCUSED VERIFY LIMITATION: tools/tubuild.py verify reports 32/37 because objisolate rejects an R_ARM_ABS32 relocation with addend zero against a vtable emitted by the same object. The five affected functions are exactly the four retained C1/D1 callbacks plus dScMgCard_c_classInit. Their extracted bytes match individually and all 37 emitted text sections occur in cartridge order; the production linker and full ROM build are the authority for their same-object relocation resolution.

2026-08-31 conversion to real members: the twenty-eight tubuild extern "C" free functions became real member functions -- dScMgCard_c's own scene logic (RenderHud, UpdateState, the hand-evaluation family SettleHand/ArrangeHand/MarkSingles/EvaluateHand/CompareHands/AllLifted/AllInState/CountInState/FindInState/DrawCardValue/FillWeights, the adjudicated vtable-slot events OnYoshiTryEat/OnTurnIntoEgg/OnGroundPounded) and the element motion members FlyOff/SetHome/Redeal/DealIn/GetOffscreenY/Render/Update over the RTTI-confirmed element classes dMgCardObj_c/dMgDilarCardObj_c. The header retype of mArray1/mArray2 from raw byte arrays to the element classes is destructor-neutral (measured) and unlocks UpdateState's member spellings. Each function was byte-verified with tools/match.py as it converted, and the hash dumps bracketing the final respells show every then-enrolled function section identical to the matched baseline.

COINED NAMES, the one thing not provable: the twenty-eight renamed functions' ROM symbols are address-only (func_ov006_020d96e0..func_ov006_020db9dc), so no recovered spelling exists to confirm or contradict the behavioral names. RenderHud, UpdateState, SettleHand, ArrangeHand, MarkSingles, EvaluateHand, CompareHands, AllLifted, AllInState, CountInState, FindInState, DrawCardValue, FillWeights, FlyOff, SetHome, Redeal, DealIn and the element Render/Update/GetOffscreenY are coined from what each function does; OnYoshiTryEat/OnTurnIntoEgg/OnGroundPounded are the family's adjudicated legacy recovered names (vtable slots 18/19/21, notes/minigame-family-decisions.md); the two element D1 symbols are the compiler's own mangling of the classes this TU's _ZTI/_ZTS proves. The coinage is disclosed here, in the per-function banner comments, and in symbols/actor_renames.tsv's why column.

D3 declarations: Sound::PlayBank2_2D, GX::LoadOBJPltt, GXS::LoadOBJPltt, G2x::SetBlendAlpha, ApproachLinear and ApproachLinear2 are declared at their RATIFIED_TRUE_NAMES forms (parameter types read off the mangled names, see the engine-helpers banner in the source); func_ov006_020c0aa8 and func_ov006_020c1804 keep the void* spellings shared with dScMgBSC_c/dScMgMCarlo2_c, and func_ov006_020c1a88 this TU's extern int (char*) form, because redeclaring a C-linkage symbol with different parameter types is an illegal overloading. The local shadow types (Node, Five, Struct30, OamAttrTmpl, Slot6, Obj6 and kin) are byte-exact struct spellings of raw-offset object headers the family has not yet carved; retiring them belongs to a header carve, not this TU.
